title: Semantic Capability Contract Schema v1
description: Formal contract schema for declaring deterministic capabilities, verification tiers, execution side-effects, and typed I/O boundaries across the personal AI capability mesh.

$schema.description: URI of the capability contract schema version.

module.description: Canonical name of the ecosystem tool/module (e.g., AI-Constraint-Solver, NovaOptimizer, SPARK).

version.description: Semantic version of the capability contract (e.g., 1.0.0).

location.description: Canonical disk path or URI for the local repository root (e.g., F:\AaradhyaDT\AI).

tracking_branch.description: Dedicated tracking branch in the central brainstorm repository (e.g., AI, super-nlm, system-optimizer).

runtime.description: Primary execution runtime environment (e.g., python3.11, dotnet10, cpp-esp32, kotlin2.2, node-vite, svelte-vite, powershell7).

mcp_endpoint.description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration if exposed to the orchestrator.

command.description: Executable command to launch the MCP server.

capabilities.description: List of discrete capabilities provided by this module.

id.description: Unique snake_case identifier for the capability within this module.

description.description: Human- and LLM-readable description of what this capability performs.

category.description: Taxonomic category within the 4-Tier Jarvis Capability Mesh.

deterministic.description: True if identical inputs strictly guarantee identical outputs with zero stochasticity.

side_effects.description: False if purely functional; true if it mutates disk, memory, network, hardware, or OS kernel state.

verification_tier.description: Epistemic verification level enforced on output claims.

cost_tier.description: Financial and compute tier required to invoke this capability.

objective.description: Optimization or proof objective for solvers and verification engines.

timeout_ms.description: Hard execution deadline in milliseconds before the orchestrator forcibly aborts.

invariants_checked.description: List of system invariants (e.g. INV-MEM-001, INV-EPI-001) verified by this capability.

inputs.description: Typed parameter schema specifying required and optional input arguments.

outputs.description: Typed output schema guaranteed upon successful execution.

counterexample_schema.description: Typed schema for counterexample state when a verification failure or invariant violation occurs.
